description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams' in the OrangeHRM system. The class extends a base filter parameters class, providing specific filtering capabilities related to employee skills, such as setting and getting an employee number, and specifying allowed sort fields.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for handling search filter parameters specific to employee skills, including employee number and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params object and sets the default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
